_comment: The GGUF files llama-server serves (router mode, --models-dir): `dotctl llm setup` fetches each one missing from ~/models, pinned to a revision and checked against its sha256 (the Hugging Face LFS oid). The request's model id is the file name without .gguf. Decision: rules/decisions/2026-09-26-deterministic-on-the-gpu.md.
